requirements.title: Session Persistence Store
requirements.description: Session metadata (ID, created_at, last_connected, shell command) persisted in database. Sessions default to never-expire policy.

validation.notes: Session metadata stored and retrievable after create
Session list returns all active sessions
List sessions handler returns JSON array
Session management renders the current pane list, its empty state, and session actions
BAS case verifies sessions remain listed by API after workspace/sessions route transitions
BAS case reloads workspace and verifies same session ID and marker output are restored
Idempotency cache TTL expiry removes stale entries on Get
Idempotency cache eviction scan triggered at >100 entries

requirements.title: When an Operator Closes a Session, Archive It
requirements.description: When an operator closes a session, web-console MUST archive its metadata and conversation without permanent deletion, MUST make archived message text retrievable across sessions, and MUST require a confirmed explicit action for permanent deletion.

validation.notes: Archive preserves conversation data, supports undo, and returns collapsed reopen lineages with honest restore states
Cross-session archive search uses FTS5 and excludes live sessions
The UI close action archives and never invokes permanent deletion; focused SessionSidebar and ArchiveDrawer validation passes
The archive drawer searches messages, reads transcripts, reopens sessions, and owns crash-orphan recovery actions; focused SessionSidebar and ArchiveDrawer validation passes

requirements.title: Reconnect State Restoration
requirements.description: Reconnecting WebSocket re-attaches to the existing PTY process. Client receives buffered output generated while disconnected.

validation.notes: Offline buffer delivers output generated while disconnected
Fake PTY offline buffer replay works correctly
BAS case disconnects terminal websocket and verifies delayed output replay on reconnect

requirements.title: Offline Buffer Replay
requirements.description: Offline buffer replays accumulated output in order when client reconnects. Buffer has bounded size to prevent memory exhaustion.

validation.notes: Offline buffer replay delivers output in order

requirements.title: Canonical Lifecycle Receipts
requirements.description: For every archive, undo, recover, dismiss, retention, or permanent-delete mutation, web-console MUST persist one replay-safe receipt containing the operation identity, prior state, resulting state, standing, and failure outcome; retrying the same operation MUST return the original result.

validation.notes: Archive receipt is durable and replay-safe
Successful replay returns the original lifecycle result
Concurrent receipt creation converges on one durable operation

requirements.title: Explicit Permanent Deletion
requirements.description: Permanent deletion MUST be distinct from archive and MUST refuse a request without the exact operator confirmation token; a failed artifact cascade MUST preserve the metadata needed for retry and MUST not report success.

validation.notes: Missing or incorrect DELETE confirmation is rejected
Cleanup failure remains visible and prevents false success

requirements.title: Recoverable Orphan Integrity
requirements.description: A conversation, checkpoint, or workspace pane whose session metadata is absent MUST remain classified and inspectable as recoverable integrity drift; integrity auditing MUST not delete or rewrite native source evidence.

validation.notes: Orphans are reported without mutating source projections
Catalog observation includes evidence absent from session metadata

requirements.title: Deterministic Reconciliation
requirements.description: Reconciliation MUST be dry-run by default, bind apply to the reviewed manifest hash, quarantine ambiguous identities, advance in bounded batches, and perform zero additional mutations when the same manifest is applied again.

validation.notes: Dry-run manifest is required for apply and replay
Manifest hash binds the reviewed evidence set
Fixture rollback restores the catalog preimage

requirements.title: Dependency-Independent Continuity Search
requirements.description: Local continuity search MUST find exact and partial text, pane identity, agent thread identity, and lifecycle metadata across live, archived, and recoverable records without requiring Agent Manager, Search Hub, embeddings, or an LLM.

validation.notes: Local search spans lifecycle states
Pane and agent-thread aliases resolve the incident
Search remains available when the session row is absent

requirements.title: Stable Federation Source Identity
requirements.description: When continuity records are published to Agent Manager, the source identity, lifecycle standing, aliases, and deletion signal MUST remain stable and native filesystem locators MUST NOT cross the public integration boundary.

validation.notes: Publisher sends stable source and provenance identity
Public records omit native transcript locators
Tombstone publication converges safely
